note: Annual election of Larne Urban Council, January 1933 (statutory day 16 January 1933). Five wards each returned one member. Nominations: Central, John Kirkwood; Curran, J. R. Lord; Gardenmore, J. W. Sandford; Inver, Miss Sarah Elizabeth Morrow and Thomas Shannon (the retiring member); Townparks, Captain A. Ferris. Miss Morrow withdrew on the withdrawal day, so all five were returned unopposed and there was no poll in the town (Larne Times, 7 January 1933, p. 2; Belfast News-Letter, 3 January 1933, p. 11). The Larne Times prints the Curran member as 'Mr. J. R. Lord'; the News-Letter's form is kept for that ward. Miss S. E. Morrow withdrew on the withdrawal day; the retiring member was returned unopposed, so no poll was held in Larne in January 1933. Returned unopposed.
